QUILLSOFT — FINOPS COST ALLOCATION STANDARD FA-2
  A1 Every cloud cost line is charged to the team in its "cost-center" tag.
  A2 Untagged cost in an account with a single owner team is charged to that owner team.
  A3 Untagged cost in a JOINT account is split between the owner teams using the ratio recorded for that account in the Joint Account Register. The register ratio is the only valid basis; it is not to be replaced by guesses about who created or used the resources.
  A4 Who launched a resource (creator identity) is never an allocation criterion.
